doc.vanguard_manifesto.title: VANGUARD ARMAMENTS: Field Directive 7/19 (Eyes Only)
doc.vanguard_manifesto.body:
To: Operative A. (Karlsruhe / Port Said)
From: Director Vance

The thermal vapour is holding. Satellite optics over both cities read nothing but white, and our test missiles fly unseen above the rooftops. Keep it that way.

Your covers stand: city repair crew at the Marktplatz, park guide in the Schlossgarten, harbour guard in Port Said. Pull fuses, cross wires, hand out wrong codes. Every broken machine is another delay, and every delay is blamed on the other city.

There is no war, and there never was. Karlsruhe blames Port Said; Port Said blames Karlsruhe. While they argue in the streets, our prototypes cross on the portal train line and through the canal gates.

The jammer in the pyramid base stays on until the depot in the Schlossgarten is sealed. Payment follows each completed job, as before.

Destroy after reading.
Director Vance, Vanguard Armaments
ui.circuit.hint: Click a switch to flip it · Drag the blue jumper to a terminal · Esc: step back
dlg.fritz_intro.1: Caw! Easy, friend. You've been asleep on that bench since the mist rolled in. Fritz, copper raven of Karlsruhe, at your service.
dlg.fritz_intro.3: I know every roof and every stone of this city. Stay close, I'll fly with you. Press H when you need help, and J for your journal.
dlg.anvin.1: Hey! I'm Anvin from the city repair crew. This pyramid board is fried. I took out the middle fuse and crossed the red wires. Just leave it alone, it's impossible to fix!
dlg.panel.julian: You crossed the wires on purpose... This is a circuit board lock.
dlg.circuit_solved.fritz: Caw! Power's flowing, and that jammer just died. Look, the compartment!
dlg.anvin_flees: What? Nobody fixes that board... I... I'm late for my shift.
dlg.lenses.julian: Goggles? The glass is violet... and warm.
dlg.lenses.fritz: Spectrum Lenses! Put them on, friend. Press L.
dlg.trails.fritz: There! Energy trails, glowing in the dark. They run north, into the Schlossgarten!
talk.owner.1: Read it! Tankers, poison, Port Said. It's all in the paper!
talk.owner.2: Three days of this mist. Nobody buys papers they can't read in the dark.
talk.owner.3: That repair man by the pyramid? Never seen him before tonight.
talk.anvin.1: Told you, friend. Impossible. Go home and stay out of the mist.
talk.anvin.2: City orders. Nobody touches the panel but the crew, and the crew says it's dead.
talk.anvin.3: Mark my words: this fog came from Port Said. Everybody knows it.
talk.citizen.1: Don't look at me like that. Everyone knows the fog came up the canal.
talk.citizen.2: My train's been cancelled three nights running. Three!
talk.citizen.3: The radio says stay indoors. The radio says a lot of things.
hint.circuit.1: Don't listen to Anvin! He shorted the main nodes! Look at the copper trace paths engraved on the panel lid!
hint.circuit.2: Route Node A to Node C around the outer edge, then cross Node B down to Node D through the center bridge slot!
hint.circuit.3: Flip Switches 1 and 4, then drag the blue jumper wire to the top-right terminal to complete the circuit!

journal.goal.prologue: Check the Marktplatz Pyramid & obtain a travel pass.
task.anvin: Find out what is wrong with the pyramid.
task.trail: Follow the UV trail north into the Schlossgarten.
note.founded: Founded in 1715 by Charles William (Margrave Karl Wilhelm of Baden-Durlach). The pyramid is his tomb.
note.anvin: Anvin, "city repair crew", admits he pulled the middle fuse and crossed the red wires on the pyramid's board. On purpose?
note.lid: The panel lid has copper trace paths engraved on it.
note.manifesto: A directive from Director Vance of Vanguard Armaments to "Operative A.": the fog hides missile tests from satellites, and the feud between Karlsruhe and Port Said is staged. Something waits in a depot in the Schlossgarten.
note.lenses: Spectrum Lenses: UV glass that shows hidden energy flows.
note.trails: Glowing UV trails run north from the pyramid toward the Schlossgarten.
ui.intro.1: Karlsruhe. Three nights ago, a white mist swallowed the city.
ui.intro.2: Trains stopped. Radios hiss. On every corner, people blame Port Said.
ui.intro.3: Julian came to find out why. Then the mist found him.
